title: Japanese-Style Grilled Bass Fillets
description: A delicate and flavorful bass fillet dish inspired by Japanese cuisine, featuring a sweet and savory sauce.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together sesame oil, soy sauce, honey, and grated ginger.
Season the bass fillets with salt and black pepper.
Place the bass fillets on the grill and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, toast the sesame seeds in a dry pan over medium heat until fragrant.
Once the fish is done, transfer it to a plate and brush with the sesame oil mixture.
Sprinkle the toasted sesame seeds and chopped green onions over the top of the fish.
